stopConditions: Any backpressure enforcement (hook deny, Stop veto, poison-pill) deadlocks a session or checkout - severity gates and waives must ship with the enforcement, never after.
Admission or auto-heal would mutate state it cannot attribute (foreign lease, malformed lock, baseline regeneration) - fail loud and stop.
